resources.string: A surround-view dashcam for Zeekr head units. Records the 360° surround view (and optionally the front and rear cabin cameras), with playback, Super mirror and more.
Source code, issues and releases. When reporting a problem, attach a report exported from Settings → System → Diagnostics.

Recordings go to USB drives only, not to the head unit's internal storage (except with developer options): its write endurance is limited and it can't be replaced.

• The USB drive supplied with the car is enough for basic recording.

• For higher bitrates or longer retention without using the car's own drive, add a USB drive or SSD to the left Type-C port. It is detected automatically and can be removed at any time.

• With Sentry Mode on after you leave the car, only the USB-A port stays powered. A drive on the Type-C port loses power, and recording moves to the drive on the USB-A port.

• Tested: a 128 GB USB drive, and an NVMe SSD (much faster, runs slightly warmer).

• Optane M10 drives are good value but small: about the last 20 hours of recordings, depending on capacity and bitrate.

Recordings and photos stay on your USB drive. The app does not upload them.

⚠ Recordings and photos on the drive are not encrypted. Anyone with the drive can read them.

The app goes online only when you start one of these:

• Check for updates: asks GitHub for the latest version and, if you confirm, downloads it from GitHub. No device data is sent.

• Send to phone: serves one file on your local network until you close the window.
Experimental, unofficial software, not affiliated with ZEEKR. While driving, watch the road, not this app. Recordings are not guaranteed to be complete. Use at your own risk.

This project grew out of the Singapore Zeekr Group chat. These people gave it its start:

• Jon (Singapore Zeekr Group) — explained how to install apps on the head unit. Nothing else would have happened without that.

• SW (same group) — shared the AVM Recorder project, which showed it could be done.

• Patrick (same group) — provided the key information to get started.

• Gabriel (same group) — tested the app and sent feedback.

• Special thanks to the Singapore Zeekr Group — a capable admin team and friendly members. A place where people share freely is rare.

Beyond Singapore, these friends helped too:

• R. Manochvarma (Zeekr Owners Community Malaysia, ZOCM) — suggested the Super mirror's button mode.

• Storm Oshyer (Zeekr 7X Australia, Facebook community) — suggested blind-spot display, turn signals and smart lane-change detection, and has kept encouraging and promoting the app.

• 理查 Richard (Zeekr 7X Australia owners' WeChat group) — suggested triggering recording from the horn and other signals.

• Members of the Bilibili Zeekr 7X owners' circle WeChat group, including 深藏功与名, G.T, 宇 and many others — for showing what the Chinese-market 7X can do, what the pioneers have already built, and what long-term use teaches.

• Myself — for enthusiasm and curiosity.

• Everyone using this app — I hope it makes driving a little easier.

• ZEEKR and Geely — for bringing us together, and for a great car and team.
Released under the GNU GPL v3.0 and based on EVCam by suyunkai, which provides the camera, recording and floating window foundations. As the GPL requires, the source code is public.
